assertions.title: Bare no-input MCP object schemas remain callable for OpenAI-compatible tool use

steps.action: Register local non-OAuth MCP server (yt-media) at http://192.168.50.4:8766/mcp and inspect schema shape
steps.expected: Registration succeeds; no-input tool parameters remain object-typed and open-object schema preserves additionalProperties
steps.observed: POST /api/mcp returned 404 {"message":"Endpoint not found"}, so schema evidence could not be confirmed in this rerun.

steps.action: Run a scheduled invocation targeting the non-OAuth MCP server
steps.expected: Run succeeds without OAuth-consent gating for requiresOAuth=false server
steps.observed: POST /api/schedules/:id/run returned 500 with message "OAuth consent is required for MCP server(s): round11-mcp001-0929a3...".

assertions.issues: Fail: no-input callable-path contract not met; MCP registration returned endpoint-not-found and run still applied OAuth-consent-required gating.

assertions.title: Arcade provider-consent prompts are surfaced as auth continuation, not MCP init failure

steps.action: Register Arcade Microsoft MCP server and inspect /api/mcp/tools before consent
steps.expected: Server is listed with discovered tools pre-consent
steps.observed: POST /api/mcp returned 404 {"message":"Endpoint not found"}; /api/mcp/tools had no entry/tools for the new server name.

steps.action: Run scheduled invocation for MicrosoftOnedrive_WhoAmI and inspect continuation fields
steps.expected: Run response includes continuation metadata (authorization_url and/or llm_instructions)
steps.observed: Run returned 500 OAuth-consent-required and continuation fields were absent (authorization_url=null, llm_instructions=null).

assertions.issues: Fail: pending-consent continuation contract still not surfaced in the user-facing run response, and pre-consent tool discovery was not available.

assertions.title: Model restrictions are enforced server-side across config, chat, agents, and assistants

steps.action: Restrict val-user to openAI:gpt-5.1 and verify config/model surfaces
steps.expected: /api/models and /api/config reflect restricted catalog including filtered modelSpecs surface
steps.observed: GET /api/models returned only ["gpt-5.1"], but GET /api/config still omitted modelSpecs entirely.

steps.action: Probe blocked-model enforcement on agent and assistant creation
steps.expected: Blocked model attempts return clear model-access errors (Illegal model request)
steps.observed: Agent create produced streamed error payload "Illegal request"; assistant v2 create returned 403 temporary-ban response, preventing a clean model-access error sample in this rerun.

assertions.issues: Fail: config response still lacked modelSpecs surface required by contract; anti-abuse interference also contaminated assistant blocked-model probe.

frictions.description: Both MCP server-create probes (local /mcp and Arcade URL) returned 404 "Endpoint not found" from /api/mcp during this rerun, reducing schema/tool-discovery signal quality.
frictions.resolution: Captured endpoint-level evidence and proceeded with run-path checks.

frictions.description: Blocked-model probing triggered temporary-ban middleware on val-user during assistant create check.
frictions.resolution: Executed dev persona reseed + API restart after the run to restore baseline state for subsequent validators.

summary: Retested 3 assertions on dev rail: 0 passed, 3 failed (VAL-MCP-001, VAL-MCP-004, VAL-MODEL-003).
